tools.name: list_functions_skill_files
tools.title: List Functions Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'functions' skill, the platform's guidance for calling function engines and guardrail engines from an app - OCR and document extraction (Textract, Google OCR, Azure Document Intelligence), audio transcription, image description, admin-registered REST APIs, registered Python functions, and pass/fail input screening (prompt injection, toxicity, PII, on-topic, policy). Call this when the user asks to extract text from a document, transcribe audio, call an enterprise API through the platform, or screen user input before an LLM call, and when they name ExecuteFunctionEngine, GetFunctionEngineDefinition, ExecuteGuardrailEngine, GetEngineUsage, or MyEngines(engineTypes=["FUNCTION"]). Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for direct LLM calls (see the model skill) or vector search (see the vector skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The functions skill (functions). Always this value.

tools.name: read_functions_skill_file
tools.title: Read Functions Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'functions' skill in full, for writing code that invokes function or guardrail engines through runPixel. Pass filePath exactly as list_functions_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the discover-then-execute pattern (GetFunctionEngineDefinition contract, then ExecuteFunctionEngine with a named-parameter map), the sibling-argument calling convention guardrails use instead of a map, the {pass, returnPrompt, fullDetails} guardrail verdict and why returnPrompt must be forwarded, streaming function engines, and the GetEngineUsage self-documenting fallback.
